title: Phased Return to Automatic Control — OT Plan 8.4 Initiated

fields.headline: Phased Return to Automatic Control
fields.narration: I am approving a phased return to automatic control under the OT Plan return-to-service checklist (Section 8.4). First, verify the HMI and PLC-02 program on a test server using the latest verified logic. Second, restore the HMI application on MBW-BKP-01 after a full integrity check. Third, perform a manual verification of the NAOH-FC-203 setpoint and pump status at the local panel before re-arming. No remote access will be permitted until the vendor's signed access request is approved and the forensic review is complete.
keyFacts: The return to automatic control is now authorized under OT Plan 8.4
The HMI and PLC-02 program must be verified on a test server before any system change
MBW-BKP-01 must undergo full integrity verification before HMI restoration
Manual verification at the local PLC-02 panel is required prior to re-arming
No remote access will be allowed until the signed Kessler Controls access request is approved and the forensic review is complete
fields.expectedAction: The Incident Commander authorizes a phased return to automatic control. The SCADA / IT Security Manager must follow the OT Plan return-to-service checklist (Section 8.4) and verify all components before any re-arming.
